prompt: Add a RemoteLogDeletionConfig class next to Kafka's remote log manager config, following that class's conventions (PROP/DOC/DEFAULT constants, a static configDef(), a wrapped AbstractConfig, one typed getter per key). Four settings: remote.log.deletion.enable (boolean, default false), remote.log.deletion.thread.pool.size (int, default 2, at least 1), remote.log.deletion.batch.size (int, default 100, at least 1), remote.log.deletion.retry.backoff.ms (long, default 500, at least 0). Each needs a doc string. Don't write tests or change existing files.
